title: Senior Analyst
description:
**Role Summary**
================

We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI/ML Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Agentic system design:** Architect and build single- and multi-agent systems with planning, tool use, memory, reflection, and human-in-the-loop controls for complex business workflows.
* **LLM implementation:** Integrate and optimize LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Llama, Mistral) via APIs
* **RAG pipelines:** Design retrieval-augmented generation solutions, including chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, and vector database management.
* **Tool and integration layer:** Implement function/tool calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to connect agents with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources.
* **Prompt and context engineering:** Develop robust prompts, system instructions, structured outputs, and context-management strategies (including prompt caching) to maximize quality and cost efficiency.
* **Evaluation and observability:** Build evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing) and monitor agents for accuracy, latency, cost, hallucination, and drift.
* **Leadership:** Mentor junior engineers, conduct code and design reviews, contribute to reusable accelerators, and support pre-sales technical discussions and PoCs.

**Required Skills**
===================

* 5-8 years of experience in AI/ML or software engineering, with at least 1 or 2 years building LLM/GenAI applications in production.
* Strong Python proficiency; experience with FastAPI/Flask, async programming, and clean, testable code.
* Hands-on experience with the Anthropic Claude API/SDK (messages, tool use, extended thinking, prompt caching, vision, batch processing) and at least one other LLM provider.
* Proven experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK.
* Working knowledge of MCP, tool/function calling, and multi-agent orchestration patterns (planner-executor, supervisor, router, reflection).
* Solid understanding of embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma) and search relevance tuning.
* Experience with fine-tuning open-source models, and inference serving Ollama.
* Collaboration with data engineers, product owners, architects, and client teams.

title: Associate Staff Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**We're Nagarro.**

We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

 **Job Description**

**Requirements**

* Experience: 4+years
* Experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or applied AI, including at least 1–2 years of hands-on experience building production-grade LLM applications.
* Expert-level proficiency in React.js for developing scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for AI development, automation, backend services, and API integration.
* Working knowledge of Java for backend services, REST API development, and enterprise application integration.
* Practical experience with LLM providers and APIs, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms.
* Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, system prompts, structured outputs, JSON schemas, function calling, and tool integration.
* Strong understanding of LLM application development, AI assistants, agentic workflows, and enterprise AI integration.
* Experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience implementing RAG pipelines, including embeddings, document chunking, retrieval tuning, grounding, and vector database integration.
* Experience with at least one vector database or search platform, such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Azure AI Search, or Vertex AI Vector Search.
* Working knowledge of LLM evaluation methodologies, including evaluation datasets, regression testing, and frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, or LangSmith.
* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asynchronous programming, Python packaging, and testing frameworks.
* Basic frontend development knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with backend API development experience.
* Knowledge of Shell scripting, Linux fundamentals, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Basic understanding of Infrastructure Security concepts, including vulnerabilities, patch management, security logs, IAM, and access controls.
* Awareness of responsible AI and security practices, including prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, bias, and content filtering.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk, including the ability to write KQL or SPL queries for AI-assisted security detection and investigation.
* Basic understanding of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and cloud security controls such as Network Security Groups (NSGs), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), IAM policies, and conditional access.
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Bicep for cloud-native AI service deployment and configuration.
* Exposure to data privacy and regulatory requirements applicable in India, including the DPDP Act and RBI IT Risk Framework, particularly in handling personal and sensitive data within AI systems.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts, including CVE, CVSS, EPSS scoring, CISA KEV catalogue, and patch prioritization workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug LLM behavior across prompts, retrieval pipelines, and tool integrations.
* Ability to interpret evaluation metrics, application logs, and security telemetry to improve AI quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ownership of AI solutions from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, testing, and documentation.
* Strong learning agility and adaptability to evolving AI models, frameworks, tools, and development practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
* Certifications such as CISSP, Associate of ISC², CEH, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), CCSP, or Google Associate Cloud Engineer are preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered features, AI assistants, and intelligent automation solutions for Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) workflows.
* Build AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability summarization, log triage, remediation recommendations, security policy reviews, configuration assessments, and natural-language querying of security data.
* Develop scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications using React.js for AI-powered internal tools and dashboards.
* Build and maintain backend AI services and APIs using Python, with Java-based backend development wherever required.
* Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and open-source models into enterprise applications.
* Design and optimize prompt templates, system prompts, structured-output schemas, and function-calling workflows.
* Implement end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document chunking, embeddings, vector store integration, retrieval optimization, and response grounding.
* Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Build evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and regression test suites to measure LLM accuracy, hallucination rates, response quality, latency, and cost.
* Continuously improve prompt engineering and AI outputs through offline and online evaluations.
* Implement responsible AI and security controls, including prompt-injection protection, PII redaction, output filtering, rate limiting, audit logging, and access management.
* Integrate AI services with vulnerability scanners, ticketing platforms, SIEM solutions, monitoring tools, and other security infrastructure to enable automated workflows.
* Automate AI/ML operations activities such as data preparation, embedding refresh, evaluation runs, health checks, and monitoring using Python and Shell scripting.
* Test, debug, and optimize AI applications to ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, deployment artifacts, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, engineering, DevOps, and data teams to translate business requirements into practical AI-driven solutions.
* Apply infrastructure security principles and cloud security controls while designing and deploying AI services.
* Continuously explore emerging LLM models, frameworks, prompting techniques, and evaluation methodologies to improve solution quality and security posture.

  
**Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: DevSecOps Engineer AI-First
description:
**About Us:**

ClearRoute is an engineering consultancy bridging Quality Engineering, Cloud Platforms and Developer Experience. We help enterprises reliably bring high-impact digital products to market faster, cheaper, and safer, working with technology leaders facing complex business challenges.

We take as much pride in our people, culture and work-life balance as we do in making better software. We’re not just making better software. We’re making the making of software better. Collaborative, entrepreneurial and dedicated to problem solving, we bring the step change our customer need to sustain innovation. Our values challenge us to do the best we can for ClearRoute, our customers and most importantly our team. This is an opportunity for you to build the organisation from the ground up, use your voice to drive change and help transform organisations and problem domains.

**Role:**

We are hiring a DevSecOps Engineer to join our AI-first Developer Platform team. The team owns the CI/CD pipelines that every engineer here ships through. We also build our own products on top of GitHub, Artifactory, and a Kubernetes-hosted marketplace of build runners.

This is a hands-on build role in a regulated environment. You will build working software, not documents. You will own products, tools, services and security from end to end, and what you ship reaches delivery teams the same week. We assess evidence over years. Show us what you have built, what you measured, and a decision the measurement changed.

**About the Role**

Build working prototypes, and harden the ones that prove their value. Put agents to work on the toolchain, for example remediation at scale, pipeline upgrades, scanner triage and credential rotation. Design how autonomous agents are allowed to act. This includes identity, scoping, audit trail and a stop control. Create new products on our platform, such as self-serve dashboards, MCP servers, skills and developer tooling. Make the secure, correct path the default in the pipeline, so developers do not have to do more, earlier. Run time-boxed experiments, each with a decide-or-kill date and a written verdict. Make the estate observable, through monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting. Talk to delivery teams directly, and bring back findings that change the roadmap. Help run the platform, using zero-downtime practices that are defined in code and tested before release.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Build working prototypes, and harden the ones that prove their value. Put agents to work on the toolchain, for example remediation at scale, pipeline upgrades, scanner triage and credential rotation. Design how autonomous agents are allowed to act. This includes identity, scoping, audit trail and a stop control. Create new products on our platform, such as self-serve dashboards, MCP servers, skills and developer tooling. Make the secure, correct path the default in the pipeline, so developers do not have to do more, earlier. Run time-boxed experiments, each with a decide-or-kill date and a written verdict. Make the estate observable, through monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting. Talk to delivery teams directly, and bring back findings that change the roadmap. Help run the platform, using zero-downtime practices that are defined in code and tested before release.

**Required Experience:**· **6 to 9 years**

* Test-driven and behaviour-driven development as your default way of working, including for pipelines, infrastructure and agents.
* Practical DevSecOps, where teams own their pipelines and security is part of building.
* Trunk-based development, with short-lived branches. Pairing as a normal way of working. Infrastructure as code, reviewed and tested as code.
* Measuring a problem first, then testing each solution against that measurement. Real experience with observability, including monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting.
* Experience driving delivery metrics toward elite DORA performance, and understanding that the system matters more than the number.
* Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot, and interest in how engineering changes in an AI-first world.
* Some experience with CI/CD platforms, patterns and practices, and genuine interest in where they are going next..

**Desirable Experience:**

* Experience with C#, Python or TypeScript.
* Experience with Terraform, AWS or Azure. Experience with GitHub, Azure DevOps or Artifactory.
* Product instinct: you ask who the user is and what they will adopt before you ask what is technically interesting.
* Experience teaching others through pairing, writing or speaking internally.

**Working at ClearRoute**  
We have grown from six founders to 180+ people across five countries in three years, and what sets us apart isn't the pace, it's how we grow.

* **Real flexibility, in practice.** We trust you to perform at your best and still have a life outside of work, with genuine hybrid working, a home office budget, an open feedback culture where your voice shapes decisions, and time off when life needs it (birthday included).
* **When ClearRoute wins, you win.** We offer profit share so success is shared, meaningful recognition for great work, and benefits that look after you and your family, including private healthcare, competitive salary benchmarking, and a confidential employee assistance program covering counselling, mental health support, and financial wellbeing.
* **A community you'll genuinely want to be part of.** Interest based communities like running and book clubs, Women in Tech group, monthly socials, and cross regional events bring people together across the company. An inclusive, collaborative culture where you don't need to conform to succeed, where people support one another and feel comfortable being themselves.
* **Where meaningful work meets real growth.** You will tackle complex, real world problems at the forefront of platform engineering, AI, security, and scalable systems. Your growth is supported by learning budgets, Udemy access, a clear career framework, internal mobility, and thought leadership opportunities that take your impact beyond ClearRoute.

*At ClearRoute, we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes, and inclusion creates the conditions for everyone to thrive. We are proud to have built a family friendly working environment and have many employees who have caring responsibilities alongside work. We welcome applications from people who require flexibility and will be happy to discuss needs on an individual basis.*

*We are committed to fostering a culture where all team members feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We celebrate individuality and our differences and understand that some differences may mean that you require changes made to the interview process. We are happy to cater to your needs to make the interview accessible, if this is something you require please let us know by emailing us at* *join@clearroute.io*

title: AI Apprentice
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Performs a structured vocational training in a specified technical functional area, with the intention of getting a recognized practical qualification.

**Job Description:**

We're looking for a curious, motivated AI Intern to join our team. This is a hands-on role where you'll work alongside engineers and researchers on real AI/ML projects, from prototyping models to deploying them. You'll gain exposure to the full lifecycle of building AI products and have the opportunity to ship work that goes into production.

**What You'll Do:**

* Assist in building, training, and evaluating machine learning and deep learning models
* Work with large language models (LLMs) — prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
* Clean, preprocess, and analyze datasets to support model development
* Write clean, well-documented Python code and contribute to internal tools and APIs
* Help benchmark model performance and run experiments to improve accuracy and efficiency
* Read recent AI research papers and share insights with the team
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and design teams to integrate AI features into our products

**Who You Are:**

* Final-year or recently graduated student from a B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech program in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Electronics, or related fields
* Solid programming foundation in Python; familiarity with Git
* Hands-on experience (coursework, projects, or hackathons) with at least one ML framework — PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn
* Understanding of core ML concepts: supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, evaluation metrics, overfitting
* Comfortable with data manipulation libraries — NumPy, Pandas
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn quickly
* Good written and verbal communication

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience working with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face) or building chatbots/RAG systems
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) or containerization (Docker)
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, or LangChain / LlamaIndex
* Open-source contributions, Kaggle competitions, or a personal portfolio of AI projects
* Research publications or coursework in NLP, computer vision, or reinforcement learning

**What You'll Get:**

* Mentorship from experienced AI engineers and researchers
* Exposure to real production systems and modern AI tooling

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work**: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

**Data Privacy**: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

**Beware of Job Scams:** Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

**To all recruitment agencies**: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Purpose:**

HVAC is a specialized branch of Mechanical Engineering. A person needs exclusive Knowledge of ASHRAE Fundamentals / CIBSE / SMACNA / Standards & NBC guidelines.

**The Role**

***As a Field Engineer III with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

An HVAC Site Engineer is required to perform below mentioned major activities:

* Understand the approved HVAC design basis, drawings, specifications, equipment data sheets and contract scope before execution.
* Ability to read and interpret HVAC layouts, P&IDs, isometrics, sections and 3D models (Revit / S3D / Navisworks).
* Supervise installation of HVAC equipment viz. (a) AHU (b) PAC (c) Air washer (d) FCU.
* Ducting execution – Ensure fabrication, installation, supports, insulation and leak testing of ducts as per ASHRAE / SMACNA Standards.
* Verify room wise air flowrates, static pressure, temperature, RH and room pressurization during Testing, Adjusting & Balancing (TAB).
* Carry out material inspection on receipt, maintain material reconciliation and raise non-conformance reports where required.
* Prepare and track daily / weekly progress reports, site measurements, joint measurement records and contractor bill certification.
* Ensure site installation matches the clash free 3D model; raise and close site queries (RFIs) and prepare as-built markups.
* Co-ordination with Civil, Architecture, Piping, Electrical, Instrumentation and Safety Teams.
* Co-ordination with Owner’ s Teams, as well as vendors and sub-contractors.

**Additional Responsibilities:**

* Lead pre-commissioning, commissioning and performance testing; witness Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) and support handover to the client.
* Enforce site safety (HSE) practices, work permits, PPE usage and quality procedures (ITP / QAP) at all times.
* Participate in site co-ordination meetings, space utilization meetings, adequacy checks of existing HVAC installations, layout studies and resolution of site constraints etc.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with additional relevant experience may be considered).
* 15-20 years of site execution experience in HVAC for industrial, pharmaceutical, clean room, data centre or commercial projects.
* Exposure to clean room projects (ISO 14644-1 classifications) and HEPA filter installation / integrity testing will be an added advantage.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Senior Principal DFT Engineer
description:
**Description**

  
  
**Invent the future with us.**  
  
  
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.  
  
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.  
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!

**About the role:**

The ideal candidate will work with multi-functional global teams to design, implement and verify Boundary Scan, ATPG (Stuck-AT/AT-Speed) SCAN, MBIST, IO BIST and JTAG/IJTAG DFT features on our next generation highly complex server class processor products. Will work in close collaboration with test engineering team to deliver ATE patterns and post silicon bring-up and debug.  
  
**What you'll achieve**:  

* DFT features like EDT, SSN, shared bus based MBIST insertion, ijtag, simulation and debug on RTL and gates netlist for automotive applications.
* Verification of jtag/ijtag, MBIST features in RTL and GLS.
* Boundary Scan insertion, simulation and verification.
* Hands on knowledge in state-of-the-art EDA tools for DFT, design and verification (Mentor, Cadence, Synopsys)
* STA DFT Test mode timing constraint development and analysis
* In-depth knowledge of Verilog HDL and experience with simulators and waveform debugging tools
* ATE silicon debug and utilize scripting with perl/Tcl for efficient handling of ATE data

**About you:**

* M.Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 8+ years of semiconductor experience or B.Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 12+ years of semiconductor experience
* Expert with methods and techniques to design, implement and verify regular and shared bus based Memory BIST on repairable and non-repairable memories using Electrical fuses.
* Expert knowledge and practical work experience partnering with designers to implement highly customized and tools-driven MBIST solutions.
* Solid understanding of MBIST algorithms needed for 5nm and lower technology nodes and ability to code new algorithms, operation sets supporting tool driven solutions for functional safety applications.
* Experience in implementing EDT, SSN, IST, boundary scan, jtag/ijtag features.
* Work independently to generate test plans, run simulations and debug failures on RTL and Gate Level
* Hands on experience in the usage of industry standard tools, like Siemens Tessent Shell flow, or Synopsys SMS/SHS flow
* Experience in Multimedia subsystems DFT (Image, display, video etc.)
* Expert understanding tradeoffs to optimize coverage and test time reduction with the ability to foresee physical implementation and timing challenges during early development.
* Experience in working with physical design teams to support STA constraints, reviewing timing reports.
* Expert in using silicon debug/diagnosis tools to root cause silicon bringup and production test issue.
* Experience in setting up and running Scan DRC flows in RTL.
* Experience with industry standard simulation tools, including Verilog, and scripting languages like Perl, Python, Shell or Tcl.
* Experience in revision control systems like GIT, perforce etc..
* Needs in depth experience in stuck at, transition delay, path delay, etc. coverage loss analysis and identifying solutions to improve test coverage
* Experience in leading the effort to derive cell aware fault models and develop necessary flows to generate ATPG and to support silicon debug.
Good knowledge of functional safety, clock domain crossing analysis, logic synthesis and scan insertion  

  
  
  
**What we’ll offer:**  
  
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.  
  
Benefits highlights include:

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

  
And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

title: Senior Modern Workplace Engineer
description:
**About Onit**

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using **AI at the core** to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

**Position Summary**

This is a hands-on Senior Modern workplace engineer role focused on modern endpoint engineering, device identity, security, automation and lifecycle management. The role will own and evolve Microsoft's modern workplace stack with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot at its core, integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint security, application deployment and patching. The successful candidate should be strong enough to solve complex L3 issues independently, but broad enough to understand how endpoint, identity, security and user experience work together.

**Onit's technology environment changes quickly. The successful candidate will be evaluated not only on what they already know, but on how effectively they learn, apply and operationalize new capabilities.**

### **What This Role Is Expected to Deliver**

* Build a secure, scalable and low-touch endpoint platform for Windows devices, with increasing capability across macOS.
* Reduce manual administration through PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and proactive remediation/automation.
* Improve device compliance, deployment quality, patch posture and endpoint security without creating unnecessary friction for users.
* Own endpoint-related projects from design and pilot through production rollout, documentation, change communication and operational handover.
* EPM, SAAS Management, Shadow IT/AI and AI Governance are key projects in Pipeline.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy and administer Microsoft Intune for device compliance, configuration profiles, security baselines, enrollment, application deployment and update management.
* Own Windows Autopilot end to end, including device registration, hardware hashes, deployment profiles, Enrollment Status Page (ESP), user-driven and pre-provisioned scenarios, troubleshooting and lifecycle operations.
* Design and maintain Conditional Access controls tied to compliant/corporate devices, MFA and Zero Trust access principles in partnership with security and identity stakeholders.
* Manage the endpoint-related Microsoft Entra ID surface, including device identity, registration, join states, authentication dependencies and access troubleshooting.

description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data**

Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos.

You will:

* Design and build key components of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service.

* Design and build **agent runtimes and harnesses**: tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Design, build and secure **MCP servers and clients**, and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs.

* Integrate and serve **LLMs**, both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control.

* Build **ModelOps / LLMOps** pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring.

* Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics.

* Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries.

* Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness.

* Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.

* Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store.

* Contribute to technical design reviews and architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions for your area.

* Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives.
  

**Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best**

You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts **across India and Silicon Valley**, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems.

You’ll also work cross-functionally with:

* Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful.

* Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries.

* Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads.

This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction.

  

**Minimum Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production.

* Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD.

* Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering.

* Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models.

* Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent.

* Experience with **ModelOps / LLMOps**: deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production.

* Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost.

* Proficiency in **Python** (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems.

* Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling).

* Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation).

* Experience implementing **AI guardrails**, red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense.

* Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI.

* Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads.

Our customer advises global pharmaceutical and life sciences clients across commercial strategy, clinical development, regulatory operations, and medical affairs. An increasing share of this work is powered by AI agents designed to handle complex scientific and commercial datasets. This role is split roughly evenly between internal research (developing reusable agent harness components, benchmark evaluations, and reliability frameworks) and client delivery (architecting, deploying, and scaling production-ready agentic systems).

 **Requirements**  

* Professional Experience: 2–3 years of professional software engineering experience, including substantive work building LLM-based or agentic systems (beyond prompt-level experimentation).

* Core Software Engineering & Python: Strong Python skills with production-grade test coverage, typing, asyncio, Pydantic, Pytest, packaging, version control, CI/CD, and robust API design.
* LLM & Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and context window management. Experience building or extending orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, deepagents, OpenAI Agents SDK, or custom harnesses) with a clear view on framework utility.
* Non-Deterministic Evaluation: Ability to define success criteria, design evaluation datasets, and systematically evaluate non-deterministic AI outputs.
* Cloud & Shipping: Working knowledge of containerization and at least one major cloud provider to ship and maintain services independently.
* Communication & Adaptability: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to represent technical positions credibly and thrive amid shifting project priorities.

**Nice to have**

* Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to healthcare, pharma, or biotech data (clinical trial data, real-world evidence, regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance, or commercial analytics) and standards (CDISC, SNOMED, MedDRA).
* Regulated Environments: Familiarity with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, audit logging, and formal system validation.
* Observability & Protocols: Hands-on experience with LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry) or developing and hosting MCP servers.
* Retrieval & Models: Experience with RAG pipelines, vector search (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate), fine-tuning, distillation, or model serving (vLLM, Bedrock, Vertex AI).
* DevOps & Data Engineering: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub Actions, AWS/Azure) alongside large-scale data processing using Polars, Pandas, DuckDB, and advanced SQL.
* Consulting & Ecosystem Engagement: Prior consulting/client services experience, active use of agentic developer tooling (such as Claude Code), or open-source contributions/publications in agent architectures and evaluations.

### **Responsibilities**

* Harness & Orchestration Architecture: Design and build core agent harnesses, covering function calling, tool interfaces, context assembly, retrieval integration, subagent delegation, retry logic, and failure handling.
* Prototype to Production Delivery: Take agentic systems from initial concept to scalable production, managing deployment, monitoring, cost, latency, and operational support against live enterprise client data.
* Evaluation Infrastructure: Build and maintain rigorous evaluation suites, task benchmarks, scoring rubrics, and regression tests using tools like Langfuse, Pydantic Logfire, or custom SDKs to drive architectural decisions.
* System & Tool Integration: Integrate client enterprise systems, data sources, and internal APIs as accessible agent tools, including building and managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
* Solution Consulting & Requirements Translation: Translate ambiguous client requirements into robust agent architectures, clearly advising stakeholders when an agentic pattern is—or is not—the right solution.
* Stakeholder Communication: Interface directly with client stakeholders and articulate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Tooling Transfer & Documentation: Contribute reusable harness components to shared internal tooling and document design decisions to meet audit, validation, and handover standards.

  
**Benefits**  

* Employment-based cooperation
* Comprehensive insurance for you and your family (health, life, and accident)
* Paid PTO policy (vacation, sick leaves, and public holidays)
* Tech equipment provided
* Udemy courses, workshops, trainings & expert knowledge-sharing
* Flexible hours & work setup

title: Project Engineer_Operations
description:
**Why This Role Exists**

The Project Engineer – Operations role exists to strengthen how construction projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered by ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows seamlessly across teams. This role transforms design data, BIM models, and project documentation into clear guidance that supports predictable outcomes, reduces risk, and improves decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

By proactively identifying issues, improving constructability, and supporting disciplined workflows, the Project Engineer enables project teams to move from reactive problem-solving to confident execution.

**Responsibility and Focus Areas:**
-----------------------------------

**Document & Models Management** – Understand, analyze, and manage the versions of construction documents & models on cloud platform ensuring the latest and greatest information is available to field team. The process can involve various Project Management Platforms like ACC Build, Procore, Bluebeam etc.

**RFI Management** – Early identification of the potential RFI’s (Request for Information) on a project through Drawings & Model based review and coordination, also understanding the raised RFI to identify appropriate details and portions of drawings impacted by RFI and link the same on the drawings for every stakeholder’s awareness.

**Submittal Management** – Understanding the project specifications and interpreting it to create submittal log. Assist the project team in creating, tracking, and managing the submittal on Project Management Platforms

**Change Management** – Through the updated Drawings and Models, assisting the project in tracking and reflecting the cost changes (due to changes in Drawings, RFI or any other factor) on the Project Management Platforms. Also, generating a scope change report by comparing the revised drawings against the current set of drawings, to help the project teams in validating cost changes.

**Construction Document & Design Review** – Review various construction documents like Design Drawings, Construction Drawings, Shop Drawings, Submittals and RFIs in the preconstruction phase to identify inconsistencies, incomplete information, and constructability issues.

**Model Based Coordination** – Leveraging BIM, identify and resolve spatial and temporal conflicts between trades virtually thereby preempting them in the field which could be costly and can derail the project schedule. Identify data inconsistencies using Navisworks.

**Quality check** models for completeness, accuracy and constructability based on design drawings and construction know-how. Use automation wherever possible.

Use **Data Visualization** means to track metrics, indicators for project progress, and quality.

**Process Improvement & Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows and tools.

* Partner with innovation teams on automation and AI initiatives.

* Document lessons learned and best practices.

**A day in this role**

The day begins with reviewing priorities, open items, and any risks that need attention. You look at model updates, documents, and change requests to ensure the information going to the team is accurate and current. Short conversations with project managers, engineers, and field teams help align what needs to move first. You support client check ins by preparing updates or clarifying next steps. You guide junior team members on technical questions or workflow challenges. You spend time coordinating with cross functional groups so information flows without gaps. You also explore improvements in the way work is done by trying new tools or refining steps that can reduce rework. Before wrapping up, you capture key learnings, update trackers, and prepare for what the next day will require.

**What You Should Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.

* 2-5 years of experience in construction operations and/or BIM

* Strong understanding of construction lifecycle.

* Strong understanding of building systems and proficiency with tools such as Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, BIM 360 or ACC, and Procore.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

We are a team of enthusiastic construction engineering and technology experts who are passionate about increasing the predictability of building better products by applying smarter processes while striving for faster delivery. We provide services and solutions to the Construction Industry in the area of Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting and Software Development. On any given day, we make an impact on several large-scale construction projects across the globe through our services and solutions.

Since we started in 2013, we are at a continuous lookout for talent driven by the vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology.

We are a subsidiary of DPR Construction, a USA based technical builder that specializes in highly complex projects in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Advance Technology, Higher Education and Commercial buildings.

title: Senior product sofware engineer
description:
**About the Role:**
-------------------

Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Your technical skills and innovative mindset will contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, making a significant impact on user experience and satisfaction.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Lead Software Development: Take the lead in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements.
* Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives.
* Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members.
* Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process.
* Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency.
* Application Design: Lead the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards.
* Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications.
* Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects.
* Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development.
* Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications.
* Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries.

**Skills:**
-----------

* Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues.
* Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality.
* Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
* Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
* Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together.
* Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
* Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes.
* Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers.
* Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a relational database, a type of database that stores and organizes data in a structured way and where data is logically interrelated. This skill often requires proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and an understanding of database design principles.
* APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other.
* Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.
* Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding.
* Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity; AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code; Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices; and Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency.

**Competencies:**
-----------------

* Analytical Skills
* Inclusive Collaboration
* Drive to Perform
* Accountability
* Functional Expertise
* Operational Expertise

---------------------------

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

title: GenAI Lead

* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution

title: Associate - Program Management
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We are modernizing Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting, moving from legacy reporting platforms to a Databricks Lakehouse-based architecture and introducing artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working. We are hiring a hands-on Product Owner / Business Analyst who combines strong regulatory reporting and data analysis experience with a modern technology mindset. You will work across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions. The ideal candidate can understand the business problem, work through the data, translate requirements into technology delivery, test the outcome, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. To accelerate delivery and improve accuracy, the role leverages agentic artificial intelligence tools while maintaining strong human-in-the-loop controls and review discipline.

Job summary

As an Associate in Program Management within Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting Modernization, you will own requirements delivery end-to-end—spanning regulatory change, business growth, general ledger optimization, technology modernization, and global alignment in data sourcing and consumption. You will partner closely with Asia Pacific Finance stakeholders (Senior Financial Officers, Legal Entity Controllers), Corporate Technology, and vendor consultants to deliver strategic reporting solutions, operate governance, and ensure high-quality, regulator-ready outputs. You will translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions and drive clear stakeholder communications. You will leverage agentic artificial intelligence tooling to support requirements extraction, impact assessment, test design, validation, and stakeholder-ready narratives, with strong review discipline.

Job responsibilities

* Own product vision and roadmap, intake, prioritization, and change control; maintain the backlog (epics, features, user stories), define minimum viable products, sequence delivery, and drive trade-offs across regulatory change versus modernization.
* Drive delivery governance cadence by preparing committee materials and providing clear, concise stakeholder communications.
* Translate regulatory circulars and business rules into business requirements documentation, impact assessments, functional specifications, and Jira epics and stories.
* Perform impact assessments for upstream system changes and data sourcing changes; define scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Finance users, Corporate Technology, and vendor teams to align the operating model and delivery approach.
* Define and implement Medallion-layer reporting logic and controls across Bronze (raw and audit-preserving), Silver (standardize, deduplicate, join), and Gold (regulator-ready rules and submission aggregations).
* Own end-to-end lineage from Gold to Silver to Bronze to source using Unity Catalog.
* Implement validation controls and pre-submission quality gates, including anomaly and outlier detection.
* Define the testing approach, scope, and plan; lead user acceptance testing with Finance and Technology.
* Build test cases and expected results; execute end-to-end tests (including automated tools where applicable), identify issues early, propose mitigations, drive timely closure, and continuously improve processes and controls.
* Use agent workflows (for example, GitHub Copilot and Databricks Genie) to accelerate requirements extraction, mapping logic, rule definition, expected-result creation, and validation; perform structured reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and governance-ready (impact summaries, control narratives, committee-ready materials).

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Accountancy, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of overall Product Owner / Business Analyst experience, including 3+ years delivering Asia Pacific local regulatory reporting automation for a foreign bank.
* Proven delivery and project management experience in Finance Regulatory Reporting automation.
* Strong data analysis skills to gather and validate facts, define gaps, perform impact analysis, draft requirements, and translate complex needs into functional specifications.
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders and produce concise written updates and governance-ready materials.
* Strong planning and time management; ability to handle multiple assignments under deadlines with proactive risk and issue management.
* Collaborative and solution-focused approach; ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
* Practical prompt engineering to drive repeatable outputs (impact assessments, mapping rules, test scenarios, defect triage summaries, stakeholder narratives).
* Ability to review and validate artificial intelligence-generated outputs against source regulatory text, control rules, and expected results (human-in-the-loop).
* Comfort using Visual Studio Code with GitHub Copilot (including Agent Mode) to accelerate requirements and test asset creation while maintaining governance standards.
* Hands-on or working familiarity with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Agile backlog tooling (Jira and Confluence), and regulatory reporting vendor platforms (Nasdaq Axiom/Adenza, Wolters Kluwer, Reveleus, Resoft).

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate or Data Engineer Associate (or Generative AI Engineer Associate).
* GitHub certification (for example, GitHub Foundations or GitHub Actions) and/or formal Copilot training or enablement.
* Substitution: 2+ years of production, hands-on experience delivering end-to-end business requirements or testing using Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, and GitHub Copilot Agent Mode in banking.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

title: Senior Control System Engineer
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**Purpose :** We are seeking an experienced Process Control Engineer with deep expertise in materials handling automation, constraint control, and throughput optimisation, capable of translating plant operating objectives into robust control strategies that consistently maximise production while maintaining stable and safe operation. Experience in large-scale mining operations would be highly advantageous.
  
  
The role is responsible for the design, implementation, tuning, and continuous improvement of constraint-based control strategies that maximise plant throughput while maintaining stable and safe operation. The role focuses on coordinating process control systems across the entire materials handling and processing circuit, ensuring production rates are optimised without causing equipment overload, blockages, or spillage.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong advanced process control, automation, and optimisation experience with expertise in bulk materials handling systems. They will have demonstrated capability in developing and commissioning constraint-based control strategies, analysing process performance, and delivering plant-wide throughput improvements through effective application of control theory, process modelling, and data-driven optimisation techniques.
  
  
To design, review, and deliver secure and resilient OT network architectures and engineering solutions that support industrial control systems, telecommunications infrastructure, digital platforms, and production-critical operational services.
  
  
The role ensures that OT network designs are aligned with client requirements, engineering standards, cybersecurity principles, industrial protocols, operational performance expectations, and project delivery objectives.
  
  
**The Role**

***As a Senior Control System Engineer with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

* Design and implement plant-wide constraint control strategies.
* Develop, configure, and commission advanced process control algorithms.
* Optimise materials handling systems to maximise throughput and minimise operational disturbances.
* Coordinate interactions between multiple process areas and control systems.
* Configure and tune PLC/DCS regulatory and supervisory control loops.
* Analyse process data to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
* Develop process simulations and material flow models to validate control strategies.
* Support commissioning, performance testing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Work closely with operations personnel to establish and maintain production targets.  

**About You**  
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  
**Job Specific Skills:**

* Advanced Process Control & Optimisation:
  + Constraint Control Strategy (CCS) design, implementation, and optimisation
  + Advanced Process Control (APC) methodologies
  + Plant-wide throughput optimisation
  + Bottleneck and constraint identification
  + Push-pull control philosophies
  + Production rate optimisation and load balancing
  + Regulatory and supervisory control systems
  + Process performance monitoring and continuous improvement
* Process Control Engineering:
  + Process dynamics and control theory
  + PID control loop design, tuning, and optimisation
  + Model-based control strategies
  + Control system stability analysis
  + Process commissioning and performance testing
  + Statistical Process Control (SPC)
  + Control narrative and functional specification development
  + Alarm management and control system diagnostics
* Materials Handling Systems:
  + Conveyor systems control
  + Crusher, screen, stockpile, and reclaim systems
  + Ore handling facilities and process plants
  + Weightometer-based flow control
  + Bulk materials flow optimisation
  + Throughput and inventory management
  + Overload and spillage prevention strategies
  + Route and equipment coordination
* Control Systems & Automation:
  + PLC programming, configuration, and troubleshooting
  + DCS configuration and optimisation
  + ABB 800xA (highly desirable)
  + SCADA systems
  + Industrial communications and interfaces
  + Control system testing and commissioning
  + Functional design specifications (FDS)
  + Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)
* Process Simulation & Analytics:
  + Process modelling and simulation
  + Material flow modelling
  + MATLAB/Simulink (desirable)
  + Data analysis and visualisation
  + Historian data interpretation
  + Performance analytics and KPI development
  + Production forecasting and scenario analysis
  + Root cause analysis
* Instrumentation:
  + Flow, level, pressure, and weight measurement systems
  + Weightometer calibration and utilisation
  + Process instrumentation selection and application
  + Instrument loop testing
  + Field commissioning and troubleshooting
  + Instrument reliability and maintenance considerations
* Mining & Industry Knowledge:
  + Iron ore processing and materials handling
  + Mining process plants
  + Production management principles
  + Safe and sustainable operations
  + Asset utilisation and operational excellence
  + Brownfield optimisation projects

**Qualifications / Requirements:**  
**Essential:**

* Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Control Systems, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years' experience in process control and automation.
* Strong background in bulk materials handling and plant-wide optimisation.
* Demonstrated experience with Advanced Process Control (APC) and constraint control strategies.
* Strong understanding of process dynamics, instrumentation, and control theory.
* Experience in data analytics and statistical process control.
* Proficiency in PLC and DCS configuration, programming, testing, and commissioning.
* Experience tuning control loops and improving process control algorithms.
* Ability to analyse process bottlenecks and optimise production systems.

**Preferred:**

* Iron ore processing and materials handling experience.
* ABB 800xA experience.
* MATLAB modelling and simulation experience.
* Mining conveyor, crushing, screening, stockyard, and reclaim systems experience.
* Plant-wide throughput optimisation and load-shedding strategies.

**Typical Technologies:**

* ABB 800xA
* PLC platforms (ABB, Rockwell, Siemens, Schneider)
* Advanced Process Control (APC)
* MATLAB/Simulink
* Weightometers and process instrumentation
* Historian and analytics systems
* Conveyor and materials handling control systems

**Other Attributes:**

* Highly organised, reliable, practical, and delivery-focused.
* Able to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail in operationally critical environments.
* Strong relationship-building skills with clients, vendors, peers, senior management, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Able to protect sensitive, proprietary, and security-related information.
* Proactive, service-minded, collaborative, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively to improve technical outcomes.
Committed to quality, safety, operational reliability, and Worley values.  

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
